messages:
hana: FYI spotted a mismatch in api-ref/classify.md. The curl example shows a response with "labels": ["spam"] but the JS snippet and the OpenAPI response schema use "label_scores": [{label: 'spam', score: 0.98}]. Which is canonical?

tom: good catch. The runtime returns label_scores (object array) for the new classifier but we historically documented labels (string list) for the legacy one. The docs page accidentally mixed both.

grace: we should pick one canonical shape and add a migration note. Prefer label_scores (more structured). Update examples for curl/python/js and the openapi. Also add a short note "legacy: labels array supported for old model versions."

hana: I'll open a docs PR to standardize on label_scores and add a small migration section. Also will update the example responses and the sample client snippets.

docs-bot: PR created https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/701 — CI: failed (example-schema-check).

tom: failing because the OpenAPI schema still shows labels: array[string]. I'll open a tiny openapi PR to change the response schema to: label_scores: array[{label: string, score: number}] and keep a deprecated labels field in description.

docs-bot: linked openapi PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/openapi/pull/123 — CI: passing.

grace: make sure to add language hints on all codeblocks and update snippet ids so the snippet generator picks them up. Also add a one-line server note: "When model version is legacy, response may include labels array for backwards compatibility."

hana: updated docs PR with example changes, added migration note, fixed language hints. Pushed.

docs-bot: Docs CI re-run: passing. Merging now.

tom: thanks everyone. I've filed a small follow-up to add an automated test that validates examples in docs against the OpenAPI response shape to catch this early (DOCS-212).

grace: great. I'll add a CHANGELOG entry: "classify: canonicalized response to label_scores array with label+score objects; legacy labels array supported for older models."

hana: closing loop — verified staging page shows consistent examples for curl/python/js and OpenAPI.
